analysis_steps.goal: Fit LTE synthetic spectra to acetamide lines

method.value: Grid of LTE synthetic spectra, best fit by minimum chi2, at the 1-beam-offset position

evidence.quote: making a grid of synthetic spectra, assuming Local Thermodynamic Equilibrium (LTE), and determining the best fit model based on the minimum $\chi^{2}$.

key_parameters.value: N scanned 5e14–5e15 cm-2 in steps of 1e14; Tex fixed at 100 or 300 K; line width 1 km/s; Vlsr 2.7 km/s

evidence.quote: Other input parameters for the synthetic spectra are kept constant, such as the line width at 1 km s$^{-1}$ and $V_{\rm lsr}$ at 2.7 km s$^{-1}$.

findings_qualitative.value: Acetamide tentatively detected (two unblended, two partially blended lines); N-methylformamide not detected

evidence.quote: two unblended and two partially blended lines are identified belonging to CH$_{3}$C(O)NH$_{2}$

claims.finding: Tentative detection with abundance comparable to high-mass sources

evidence.quote: CH$_{3}$C(O)NH$_{2}$ is tentatively detected towards IRAS 16293–2422B at an abundance comparable with those found towards high-mass sources.
